meta.source: Hamzist input pack v3 (App @ 74fbfb7) + checkpoint-1 decisions
meta.stage: Foundations approved (checkpoint 2, 10 Mehr 1405). Components and shells approved (checkpoint 3, 11 Mehr 1405). Final delivery in review.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Primitive. Pure white — page, cards, inputs, secondary buttons, text on the primary button.

tokens.name: cream-50
tokens.usage: Primitive. Logo-family cream — chrome only: header, footer, sidebars, top bars, tab bar, sticky bars (code: bg-canvas).

tokens.name: sand-100
tokens.usage: Primitive. Warm off-white — quiet fills and the neutral status background (code: bg-subtle, status-neutral-bg).

tokens.name: peach-50
tokens.usage: Primitive. Brand tint — CTA box, selected/active fills, category tags (code: bg-brand-subtle).

tokens.name: sand-200
tokens.usage: Primitive. Hairline and disabled fill — decorative dividers, disabled controls, empty-image placeholder (code: bg-disabled, border-subtle, border-disabled).

tokens.name: sand-300
tokens.usage: Primitive. Warm border — card and panel outlines, table rules, neutral status border.

tokens.name: sand-400
tokens.usage: Primitive. Disabled text only (2.13:1 — WCAG-exempt for disabled controls) (code: text-disabled).

tokens.name: sand-500
tokens.usage: Primitive. Approved addition (10 Mehr 1405). Control borders: fields, checkbox, radio, switch-off, secondary button — 3.43:1 on white.

tokens.name: sand-700
tokens.usage: Primitive. Secondary text, meta, captions, icons at rest (code: text-secondary).

tokens.name: sand-800
tokens.usage: Primitive. Neutral status text (code: status-neutral-text).

tokens.name: ink-900
tokens.usage: Primitive. Logo ink — primary text, headings, secondary-button label. Replaces the code's #171A17.

tokens.name: orange-500
tokens.usage: Primitive. Logo orange — mark, accent bar, focus ring, active borders, icons. NEVER text, NEVER a fill under white text.

tokens.name: orange-600
tokens.usage: Primitive. Primary action fill under white text only (4.55:1). Never text on light grounds.

tokens.name: orange-700
tokens.usage: Primitive. Every orange text: links, category tags, small headings, «مشاهده همه»; also primary-button hover fill.

tokens.name: logo-cream
tokens.usage: Primitive. Logo cut-out only (the shapes inside the symbol).

tokens.name: blue-50
tokens.usage: Primitive. Info status background.

tokens.name: blue-500
tokens.usage: Primitive. Info status border / dot (decorative).

tokens.name: blue-700
tokens.usage: Primitive. Info status text and icon.

tokens.name: green-50
tokens.usage: Primitive. Success status background.

tokens.name: green-500
tokens.usage: Primitive. Success status border / dot (decorative).

tokens.name: green-700
tokens.usage: Primitive. Success status text and icon.

tokens.name: amber-50
tokens.usage: Primitive. Warning status background.

tokens.name: amber-500
tokens.usage: Primitive. Warning status border / dot — decorative only (2.35:1 on white).

tokens.name: amber-700
tokens.usage: Primitive. Warning status text and icon.

tokens.name: red-50
tokens.usage: Primitive. Error status background.

tokens.name: red-500
tokens.usage: Primitive. Error status border / dot (decorative).

tokens.name: red-700
tokens.usage: Primitive. Error status text, destructive button fill under white text (6.57:1).

tokens.name: bg-page
tokens.usage: Page background in every shell (decision, checkpoint 1).

tokens.name: bg-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, tables, modals, sheets — always with border-default.

tokens.name: bg-chrome
tokens.usage: Header, footer, PublicShell/OpsShell sidebar and top bar, mobile tab bar, sticky action bars. Always separated from the page by border-default.

tokens.name: bg-feature
tokens.usage: Landing pages only (SiteShell home and section landings): feature cards — quick links, breed, community, service and step cards, the stats box, the hero verify box. Always with border-default. Never in PublicShell or OpsShell.

tokens.name: bg-band
tokens.usage: Landing pages only: one full-width section band, edge to edge (e.g. «تازه‌ها»), with border-subtle hairlines top and bottom. Cards inside the band use bg-surface (white). At most one band per page, never two in a row.

tokens.name: bg-subtle
tokens.usage: Quiet fills inside surfaces: «اقدام بعدی با» box, locked-service card, table header row, hover on secondary/ghost controls.

tokens.name: bg-brand-subtle
tokens.usage: Brand tint: CTA box, active nav item, selected radio card, category tag, avatar initials.

tokens.name: bg-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled control fill.

tokens.name: bg-media-empty
tokens.usage: Designed missing-image placeholder (brand symbol + Persian alt text in text-secondary).

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Body copy and headings on bg-page, bg-surface, bg-chrome, bg-subtle, bg-brand-subtle and every status background (≥10.39:1).

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Meta, captions, helper text, secondary labels on bg-page, bg-surface, bg-chrome, bg-subtle, bg-brand-subtle (≥5.84:1) and on bg-media-empty (5.23:1). Hierarchy vs text-primary comes from size and weight, not colour alone (1.81:1 apart).

tokens.name: text-brand
tokens.usage: All orange text: links, «مشاهده همه», category tags, small overlines — on bg-page, bg-surface, bg-chrome, bg-subtle, bg-brand-subtle (≥5.89:1).

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels only — WCAG-exempt; never for information.

tokens.name: text-on-action
tokens.usage: Label on action-primary (4.55:1), action-primary-hover (6.29:1) and action-destructive (6.57:1).

tokens.name: border-default
tokens.usage: Card, panel, header/footer, table and divider rules (decorative — structure, not meaning).

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Hairlines inside a surface: list-row separators, key-value rows.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Fields, checkbox, radio, switch-off and secondary-button outlines — 3.43:1 on white, 3.35:1 on bg-chrome (WCAG 1.4.11).

tokens.name: border-brand
tokens.usage: Active/selected outline, accent bar at the start of section titles (3.29:1 on white).

tokens.name: border-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled control outline.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element — 3.29:1 on white, 3.22:1 on bg-chrome.

tokens.name: action-primary
tokens.usage: Primary button fill — one per view. Label: text-on-action.

tokens.name: action-primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover/pressed fill (pointer devices only for hover).

tokens.name: action-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill (decision: white). Outline border-control, label text-primary.

tokens.name: action-secondary-hover
tokens.usage: Secondary and ghost button hover/pressed fill.

tokens.name: action-destructive
tokens.usage: Destructive button fill (reject, suspend, delete). Label: text-on-action.

tokens.name: accent-bar
tokens.usage: The 4px bar at the start of every section title — the system's signature.

tokens.name: logo-mark
tokens.usage: Logo symbol fill.

tokens.name: logo-cutout
tokens.usage: Logo symbol cut-outs.

tokens.name: logo-ink
tokens.usage: Wordmark «همزیست» on light grounds.

tokens.name: icon-default
tokens.usage: Icons at rest next to text-secondary.

tokens.name: icon-strong
tokens.usage: Icons in icon buttons and next to text-primary.

tokens.name: status-neutral-bg
tokens.usage: StatusBadge/Alert background for the draft + closed families.

tokens.name: status-neutral-text
tokens.usage: StatusBadge/Alert text and icon on status-neutral-bg, bg-surface and bg-page.

tokens.name: status-neutral-border
tokens.usage: StatusBadge/Alert border and dot — decorative; meaning is carried by the label text.

tokens.name: status-info-bg
tokens.usage: StatusBadge/Alert background for the waiting family — someone else must act.

tokens.name: status-info-text
tokens.usage: StatusBadge/Alert text and icon on status-info-bg, bg-surface and bg-page.

tokens.name: status-info-border
tokens.usage: StatusBadge/Alert border and dot — decorative; meaning is carried by the label text.

tokens.name: status-success-bg
tokens.usage: StatusBadge/Alert background for the done family.

tokens.name: status-success-text
tokens.usage: StatusBadge/Alert text and icon on status-success-bg, bg-surface and bg-page.

tokens.name: status-success-border
tokens.usage: StatusBadge/Alert border and dot — decorative; meaning is carried by the label text.

tokens.name: status-warning-bg
tokens.usage: StatusBadge/Alert background for the action family — the user must act.

tokens.name: status-warning-text
tokens.usage: StatusBadge/Alert text and icon on status-warning-bg, bg-surface and bg-page.

tokens.name: status-warning-border
tokens.usage: StatusBadge/Alert border and dot — decorative; meaning is carried by the label text.

tokens.name: status-error-bg
tokens.usage: StatusBadge/Alert background for the blocked family.

tokens.name: status-error-text
tokens.usage: StatusBadge/Alert text and icon on status-error-bg, bg-surface and bg-page.

tokens.name: status-error-border
tokens.usage: StatusBadge/Alert border and dot — decorative; meaning is carried by the label text.

tokens.name: overlay-scrim
tokens.usage: Scrim behind Modal, Drawer and BottomSheet: ink-900 at 48% (approved at checkpoint 2). Not a new hue — an alpha of the palette's ink, like the shadows.

styles.usage: Section title with accent-bar on phones.

styles.name: h3-mobile

styles.name: h4-mobile

styles.name: body-sm

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons (48/44px), tabs, nav items.

styles.name: label-sm
styles.usage: Small buttons (36px), field labels in dense forms, table headers.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Meta, timestamps, image captions, counters.

styles.name: id
styles.usage: Identifiers and codes inside Persian text, isolated with <bdi dir="ltr">: PET-, RS-, HZP-… Latin digits are tabular in IRANSansX.

styles.name: latin-body
styles.usage: Reserved: English UI copy once a Latin pair font is chosen (IRANSansX covers basic Latin only).

tokens.name: space-0
tokens.usage: No gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-badge nudges, focus-ring offset.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Tight inline gaps: badge dot to label, chip rows.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside buttons; gaps inside compact rows.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; list-row vertical padding (dense).

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Mobile page margin; card padding (compact); form field gap.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile; grid gutter on tablet.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Card/panel padding on desktop; grid gutter on desktop; gap between panels.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Gap between a section title and dense content; tablet page margin.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Desktop page margin at 1024; space inside large bands.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Gap between sections on mobile; hero padding.

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Gap between sections on desktop (SiteShell).

tokens.name: space-80
tokens.usage: Page margin at 1440 (container 1280).

tokens.name: space-96
tokens.usage: Top/bottom padding of editorial bands and the page end before the footer.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Tables, full-bleed images, dividers.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Progress bars, tiny indicators, keyboard keys.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tooltips, image toolbars, small thumbnails (≤64px).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Controls: buttons, inputs, selects, nav items, chips in forms (approved: B corners on A).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Inner panels and list cards inside a surface, alerts, radio cards, tabs container.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, modals, image frames in cards (approved: B corners on A).

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Large containers: CTA box, stat band, bottom-sheet top corners.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Tags, status badges, avatars, pills, switches.

shadow.note: Structure comes from border-default, not shadows. Shadows are reserved for layers that float above the page.

tokens.name: bp-desktop

tokens.name: bp-wide
tokens.usage: Wide desktop: container capped at 1280 (site) / 1200 (app content).
